announcements.title: Water Supply Maintenance - 25th May
announcements.content: Water supply will be interrupted from 9 AM to 5 PM on 25th May 2026 for maintenance of main pipeline in Adyar and T Nagar areas.

announcements.title: Property Tax Due Date Extended
announcements.content: The due date for property tax payment for the year 2026-27 has been extended to 30th June 2026. Citizens can pay online at tnmunicipal.org.

announcements.title: Volunteer Orientation Program - June 1st
announcements.content: All newly approved volunteers are requested to attend the orientation program on June 1st, 2026 at District Collectorate, 10 AM.
